title: [bug] Checkpoint restore corrupts payloads with backslash/control characters
description: DoltRepo.sq() escaped only single quotes, but dolt/MySQL string literals also process backslash escapes — so every JSON escape in a serialized payload (\n, \", \) was silently corrupted on applySnapshot INSERT (e.g. \n collapsed to a real newline). Restore of any real campaign then failed JSON.parse. Also, dolt's -r json writer does not escape control characters in string values. Found while implementing loreweaver-v3k.
acceptance_criteria: sq() escapes backslashes; readSnapshotAt and log() HEX-decode free-text columns; a checkpoint/restore round-trip of text with newlines/backslashes/quotes is covered by a test.
close_reason: Merged: v3k+6rm in PR #45, dy8 in PR #42.
